title: A versatile ethanolamine-derived trifluoromethyl enaminone ligand for the elaboration of nickel(II) and copper(II)–dysprosium(III) multinuclear complexes with magnetic properties

material_class.structural_family: nonanuclear Dy3Cu6 cluster from three condensed {Dy2Cu2O4} cubane-like moieties

synthesis.procedure: In a sealed tube, DBU was added to L1H2 in CH2Cl2. A methanolic solution of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O was added dropwise and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 20 min. A methanolic solution of CuCl2·2H2O was then added slowly and the mixture was stirred at 80 °C for 4 h. Fast evaporation under reduced pressure precipitated the crude complex, which was washed with cold methanol. Single crystals were obtained by slow evaporation of a CH2Cl2/MeOH (1/1) solution (the experimental write-up erroneously says complex 1).
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for 20 min after Dy addition, then 80 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed tube; sequential addition of Dy then Cu
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: fast evaporation under reduced pressure; wash with cold methanol; slow evaporation from CH2Cl2/MeOH 1/1

properties.summary: χMT of 2 decreases from 42.66 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature (close to 44.76 expected for 3 DyIII + 6 CuII) to 19.32 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K. Magnetization isotherms at 2–5 K indicate magnetic anisotropy and lack the 10 kOe step seen in a related cationic [Dy3Cu6] analogue. Zero-field ac susceptibility is frequency-dependent without maxima, consistent with slow magnetic relaxation/SMM behavior that is not suppressed by a small dc field.

measurements.name: ac susceptibility (in-phase/out-of-phase)
measurements.value: frequency-dependent χ′ without maxima; slow relaxation not removed by 0.01–0.1 T dc field
measurements.conditions: 2–12 K, zero dc field, 2.7 Oe ac field, 10–1400 Hz (text); also 2–10 K, 2.8 Oe, 1–1500 Hz (experimental)
